description: MEASURE a screen recording so content.recording is filled from data, not guessed. Returns crop, beatFrames and focus already in snapcn_plan_video's shape, plus one frame per beat cropped and fitted exactly as the composition will show it. Call it BEFORE snapcn_plan_video whenever the user has a recording: these are the three fields the contract says not to guess, and omitting them is not neutral — the default beat walk (0/139/278) only reaches 9.3s into a take of any length, so a 37s demo ships with its payoff never on screen.

at_seconds.description: VERIFY MODE. Skip the analysis and just return these moments of the take, cropped exactly as the composition will show them. Use it after moving a beat: pass the new opening times and look, instead of re-running the whole measurement.

beat_frames.description: Frames one screen beat runs. 139 is what screen-recording ships at and what the screen-demo recipe bills. It is load-bearing here: a beat opening later than duration - beat_frames/fps runs past the end of the take and freezes on the last frame, so every proposal is clamped to it.

beats.description: Screen beats to propose, one source frame each. 3 for product-demo's screen-demo (reveal / the moment / interaction), 2 for cli-tool-demo. Drop to 1 if you only want the reveal.

composition_aspect.description: width/height of the composition the shot lands in (1280x720 = 1.7778). Everything x/y is normalized to. A source of a different aspect is centre-cropped to this before crop applies, and points outside that window are simply not on screen — which is why this is not cosmetic.

file.description: Path to the recording (.mp4/.mov/.webm/.m4v). Absolute, or relative to project_dir. Paste the name exactly as the filesystem has it — macOS writes a NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE (U+202F) before "PM" in a screen recording's name and a retyped ASCII space will not find the file.

fps.description: The COMPOSITION's fps, not the file's. trimBefore is a Sequence offset, so beatFrames are composition frames. At 30fps a 120fps source's own 1754 frames are not numbers you can pass.

project_dir.description: Root of the user's Remotion project — the folder with package.json and node_modules. Its @remotion/cli is where ffmpeg and ffprobe come from; there is nothing else to install. Default: the directory this server was started in.
